summary: All conversion and delegation descriptions match their bodies, but every explicitly named `asJava...` alias falsely promises the identical returned object from a separate `asJava` call.

items.issue: Its `@return` says it returns the same `BiConsumer` value as `asJava`, but both methods independently allocate a new wrapper unless `underlying` is already a `FromJavaBiConsumer`.
items.suggestion: Say it returns a `BiConsumer` with behavior equivalent to `asJava`, without promising object identity.

items.issue: Its `@return` incorrectly promises the same value as `asJava`; separate calls allocate separate `AsJavaBiFunction` wrappers for ordinary Scala functions.
items.suggestion: Describe equivalent behavior rather than the same returned value.
